writer for children

Younger daughter of James Robinson Planché, the dramatist, she married (1852) the Rev.

Henry S.

Mackarness (d. 1868), brother of John Fielder Mackarness.

She was left a widow with seven children, lived with her father, wrote children's books [DNB]
